ready.description: IDs of the ready tasks under the folder, and of the ready tasks those under it wait on: working on these is what makes it done. In work order.

stuck.description: IDs no work will clear. Ascending.

stuck_folders.description: Folders whose blockers are unknown, since their folder file is missing or can't be used. Tree order.

description: What a folder waits on to be done: its open tasks, at any depth, followed as task why follows a task.
